items.title: Annie Ross interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, January 13, 2001

ctx.x: I think — that particular record is one of my favorites — and there’s some very intricate things happening and I guess I just picture arduous rehearsals.
I guess it’s not that much different than the way instrumentalists talk about going into the studio and doing an album, and the same kind of relying on your ears and your musicality.
